Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis by assuming the show was "Dulce Amor" without verifying it against the search results. The WebSurfer's search results explicitly stated that Isabel Macedo played the character Jimena Benitez (also known as Patricia Longo) in the telenovela **"Graduados"**, not "Dulce Amor". Instead of correcting this hallucination based on the evidence found, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the search results confirmed "Dulce Amor" and proceeded to declare the task complete with the wrong title.
